soal.teks: Arrange the fragments to form a complete sentence.

pembahasan.teks: **Konsep:** Frasa subjek dan pelengkap
**Kata Kunci:** is responsible, for checking, the previous month's

Urutan D–B–E–A–C menghasilkan kalimat berikut. The branch manager is responsible for checking the previous month's expense records. Subjek The branch manager diikuti predikat is responsible. For checking menyatakan tanggung jawabnya. The previous month's menerangkan expense records, yang menjadi objek checking.
Alasan opsi salah
A. Expense records muncul sebelum the previous month's, sehingga penanda kepemilikan tertinggal tanpa noun.
B. For checking diletakkan sebelum is responsible dan memutus pola responsible for.
D. Frasa the previous month's expense records muncul sebelum subjek tanpa hubungan gramatikal.
Kunci responsible for dahulu, lalu satukan penanda kepemilikan dengan noun.

soal.teks: Arrange the fragments to form a complete sentence.

pembahasan.teks: **Konsep:** Verb, objek, dan infinitive
**Kata Kunci:** requires all, newly appointed, to verify

Urutan B–E–C–A–D menghasilkan kalimat berikut. The new procedure requires all newly appointed branch employees to verify each customer signature. Requires all newly appointed branch employees menyebut siapa yang wajib bertindak. To verify each customer signature menjelaskan tindakan yang harus mereka lakukan. Each menerangkan customer signature.
Alasan opsi salah
A. Newly appointed terpisah dari branch employees oleh requires all.
B. Branch employees to verify muncul sebelum newly appointed, sehingga adjective tidak lagi menerangkan employees.
C. Branch employees to verify each customer signature muncul sebelum subjek dan predikat utama, sehingga objek requires hilang dari posisinya.
Pasangkan all dengan kelompok orang dan each dengan benda tunggal yang diperiksa.

soal.teks: Arrange the fragments to form a complete sentence.

pembahasan.teks: **Konsep:** Noun clause dengan whether
**Kata Kunci:** asked whether, the revised schedule, had been

Urutan D–A–C–E–B menghasilkan kalimat berikut. The operations manager asked whether the revised schedule had been approved by headquarters. Asked whether memperkenalkan pertanyaan tak langsung. The revised schedule menjadi subjek klausa itu, diikuti had been approved. By headquarters menyatakan pelaku persetujuan.
Alasan opsi salah
A. The revised schedule muncul sebelum asked whether dan tidak menempati posisi subjek klausa setelah whether.
C. Had been muncul sebelum subjek klausa, sehingga susunannya salah.
D. The revised schedule diletakkan di awal dan tidak terhubung dengan subjek klausa utama.
Mulai dari asked whether, lalu cari subjek dan pasangan had been + V3.
